basic_info.description: 👋 I am a passionate and experienced full-stack developer specialized in .NET and Angular technologies. With a strong background in computer science and a passion for creating high-performance, user-friendly web solutions, I have gained significant experience in developing modern, scalable web applications.

projects.title: Jaytrain
projects.description: Design and development of a web and mobile application dedicated to sports tracking, allowing users to participate in training sessions, monitor their physical and nutritional progress, and interact through a social platform.

projects.title: Impérial
projects.description: Design and development of a highly available, secure, and intuitive online lottery web application, offering an interactive experience for participating in draws.

projects.title: WebTrace
projects.description: It is a comprehensive GPS/GPRS platform composed of multiple modules, compatible with a wide range of GPS/GPRS devices, and integrated with a richly detailed cartographic database. It enables resource management (drivers, vehicles, stocks, transactions), real-time tracking and history review of mobile objects, device and account administration, real-time tank monitoring and control via IoT equipment, as well as data analysis through dashboards and exportable reports.
